newsitem.title: ITALY: Milan to issue 100 bln lire muni bonds privately.
newsitem.headline: Milan to issue 100 bln lire muni bonds privately.

text.p: The city of Milan has decided to issue 100 bln lire of 15-year municipal bonds (BOC) reserved for institutional investors.
The city said in a statement the private placement will be issued at par with a coupon based on 12-month RIBOR plus a maximum spread of 1.0 percent.
Proceeds from the issue will help pay for maintenance of council houses and the purchase of new buses.

The city, which in July got an S&P AA rating for its foreign currency debt, plans to issue a foreign currency denominated BOC for a value of 150 billion lire in early 1997 to help pay for projects such as renovating its famous La Scala opera house.
